result:
Confirmed — this file names `Role` in both an import and a type annotation (`_roleParity: Role`), so it's in scope.

I've verified all 51 candidate files individually. Final in-scope set (files that name the `Role` type via import, type annotation, type argument, or Record key):

**Type definition & direct consumers of the `Role` type:**
- `src/types/member.ts` — defines `Role`, uses it in `Record<Role, number>` and multiple annotations
- `src/types/permission.ts` — imports `Role`, annotates `targetRole: Role`
- `src/types/event.ts` — imports `Role`, annotates event payload fields
- `src/types/feature-flag.ts` — imports `Role`, annotates strategy/context fields
- `src/schemas/role.ts` — imports `Role`, annotates `_roleParity: Role`
- `src/lib/permissions.ts` — imports `Role`, uses `Record<PermissionAction, Role>`
- `src/lib/format.ts` — imports `Role`, uses `Record<Role, string>` and a parameter annotation
- `src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts` — imports `Role`, parameter annotations
- `src/server/services/member-service.ts` — imports `Role`, parameter annotation
- `src/emails/invite-email.tsx` — imports `Role`, prop type annotation
- `src/server/db/seed.ts` — imports `Role`, annotation in array type
- `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx` — imports `Role`, `useState<Role>`
- `src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx` — imports `Role`, multiple annotations
- `src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx` — imports `Role`, `Record<Role, ...>`
- `src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx` — imports `Role`, callback param annotation
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx` — imports `Role`, parameter annotation

**Tests naming `Role` (import/annotation/Record key):**
- `tests/contract/permissions.test.ts`
- `tests/config/nav.test.ts`
- `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`
- `tests/components/role-select.test.ts`
- `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts`
- `tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts`

Excluded despite containing "Role" as a substring: files using `actor.role`/`member.role`/`input.role` as bare property access, the `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` and `scripts/build-manifest.ts` documentation strings (they mention "Role" as descriptive text, not actual TS syntax), files only importing runtime schemas (`roleSchema`, `invitableRoleSchema`) or the `ROLE_RANK`/`ROLE_MATRIX` constants without naming the `Role` type, and files only referencing component names like `RoleBadge`/`RoleSelect` or JSX text "Role".

ANSWER: src/types/member.ts, src/types/permission.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/schemas/role.ts, src/lib/permissions.ts, src/lib/format.ts, src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/emails/invite-email.tsx, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx, src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx, src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, tests/contract/permissions.test.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts, tests/components/role-select.test.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts, tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts
